      Earn Blue Points on every dollar

      • 10x10 times​ the Points on Blue Rewards Travel, powered by Expedia29

        Earn 10 Blue Points for every $1 spent when you book flights, car rentals, hotels and more through Blue Rewards Travel, powered by Expedia - helping you get more out of every business trip.

      • 10x10 times​ the Points at Blue Rewards Partners29

        Earn 10 Points for every  $1 spent at participating Blue Rewards Partners, including Pharmasave, Global Pet Foods and many more. That's 10x10 times​ your base earn rate.

      • 2xTwo times​ the Points30

        Earn 2 Points for every $1 spent on gas and electric vehicle (EV) charging. That’s 2xtwo times​ your base earn rate.

      • Extra Blue Points

        Earn additional Points on top of your credit card Points when you use your physical or digital Blue Rewards Member Card at checkout.19

      Every Point adds up with a base earn rate of 1 Point for every $1 spent.20

      Redeem for all the things you want

      • Redeem and earn Blue Points for travel

        • 10xten times​​ the Points: Earn 10xten times​ the Points when you book flights, car rentals, hotels and more through our travel platform, with access to Expedia’s global inventory.29
        • More ways to pay: Redeem any amount of Points to reduce what you pay out of pocket, when using a combination of your BMO Blue Rewards credit card and Points (excluding cruises).
        • Cover your trip: Use Points to pay for your whole trip, including taxes and fees (excluding cruises and pay-at-property fees).
        • Competitive pricing: Unlock special deals to experience more of the world.

      What you’ll need to apply for a business credit card with us

      Select your type of business for a list of information you’ll need to provide.

      Here’s what you’ll need:

      • Name, address and date of birth, along with personal identification
      • Trade Name Registration (if applicable)
      • Master Business Licence (if you’re using a registered trade name)

      Here's what you'll need:

      Please consult the following list to figure out what information you may need to provide.

      If your business has been in existence less than 18 months, please provide one of the following:

      • Complete articles of incorporation
      • Letters patent/company charter
      • Articles of amendment
      • Articles of amalgamation
      • Corporate Profile Report

      If your business has been in existence more than 18 months, please provide one item from the previous list as well as one of the following:

      • Annual/statutory return
      • Certificate of status
      • Certificate of compliance/existence and any filings under the applicable provincial securities legislation, such as financial statements
      • Financial statement or annual report signed by an independent accounting firm
      • Government assessment
      • Corporate search

      If your business operates under a registered trade name, please provide one of the following:

      • Trade Name Registration
      • Master Business License

      In all cases, please provide the following identification:

      • Name, address, and occupation or nature of primary business
      • Percentage ownership and type of ownership (direct or indirect) for any person (including yourself) or company with an interest of 25 per cent or more of your business
      • Name, occupation and date of birth, along with personal identification

      Here's what you'll need:

      Please consult the following list to figure out what information you may need to provide.

      If your business has been in existence less than 18 months, please provide one of the following:

      • Complete articles of incorporation
      • Letters patent/company charter
      • Articles of amendment
      • Articles of amalgamation
      • Corporate Profile Report

      If your business has been in existence more than 18 months, please provide one item from the previous list as well as one of the following:

      • Annual/statutory return
      • Certificate of status
      • Certificate of compliance/existence and any filings under the applicable provincial securities legislation, such as financial statements
      • Financial statement or annual report signed by an independent accounting firm
      • Government assessment
      • Corporate search

      If your business operates under a registered trade name, please provide one of the following:

      • Trade Name Registration
      • Master Business License

      In all cases, please bring the following identification:

      • Name, address, and occupation or nature of primary business
      • Percentage ownership and type of ownership (direct or indirect) for any person (including yourself) or company with an interest of 25 per cent or more of your business
      • Name, occupation and date of birth, along with personal identification, for yourself and up to three authorized signatories

      Here's what you'll need:

      Please consult the following list to figure out what information you may need to provide.

      If your business is a general partnership, please bring the following:

      • Partnership registration (if applicable)
      • Partnership agreement

      If your business is operating under a registered trade name, please bring one of the following:

      • Trade Name Registration
      • Master Business License

      If your business is a limited partnership, please bring the following:

      • Limited partnership agreement
      • Certificate of limited partnership/declaration of limited partnership/application for registration of a limited partnership

      In all cases, please bring the following identification:

      • Name, address, and occupation or nature of primary business
      • Percentage ownership and type of ownership (direct or indirect) for any person (including yourself) or company with an interest of 25 per cent or more of your business
      • Name, occupation and date of birth, along with personal identification, for yourself and up to three authorized signatories

      Here's what you'll need:

      Please consult the following list to figure out what information you may need to provide.

      If your business has been formally established, please bring one of the following:

      • Articles of association
      • Copy of by-laws or constitution disclosing names and titles of directors and/or officers

      If your association isn’t formally established, please bring:

      • Letter from the organization disclosing who has the authority to open and operate the account

      In all cases, please bring the following identification:

      • Name, address, and occupation or nature of primary business
      • Percentage ownership and type of ownership (direct or indirect) for any person (including yourself) or company with an interest of 25 per cent or more of your business
      • Name, occupation and date of birth, along with personal identification, for yourself and up to three authorized signatories
      • Name and occupation of any directors or officers

      BMO Blue Rewards Business Mastercard®* FAQs

      General

      • Blue Rewards (formerly the AIR MILES®†registered trademark, dagger​ Program) is a new loyalty program designed to make your experience simple and rewarding. We’ve introduced more places for you to earn and redeem Points so you can get more from your everyday business spending.

      • You can become a Blue Rewards Member today, just visit the Blue Rewards website.

      • No, these are different rewards programs. Blue Rewards is a new loyalty program designed to make your experience simple and rewarding. BMO Rewards is a separate rewards program available only with select BMO credit cards.

      • BMO takes your security seriously and works with you to keep you safe while banking online. For more information on security at BMO, find out how we protect you.

      • For more information on the transition from AIR MILES®†registered trademark, dagger​ to Blue Rewards, please visit our transition page.

      Points and rewards

      • You collect Points on eligible purchases when you show your Blue Rewards Member card or use a Blue Rewards credit card or debit card to pay. Your everyday spending adds up to rewards you can use.

      • Get all the details about redeeming Points on the Blue Rewards website.

      • You can access your Blue Rewards Summary on your Mastercard monthly statement. It will display the number of Points you got on purchases for the stated period but won’t include Points from bonus or promotional offers.

        You can also check your Points and balances when you sign in to BMO Online Banking or the BMO Mobile Banking app, on your Blue Rewards Member Summary statement, and through the Blue Rewards website.

      Credit cards

      • The perks of the BMO Blue Rewards Business Mastercard®* include no annual fee and a welcome bonus that lets you earn up to 30,000 Blue Points.‡‡ For more information, go to the benefits section on this page.

      • Yes! Purchases made with this card can be broken up into smaller monthly payments through PaySmart.
